03-warn-soft-bans.md.notes: Contains SECONDARY banned words only: innovative, scalable, proud to. Also has vague proof (many of our clients, significant improvements) and product narrative uses 'solutions' instead of outcome framing. Verdict MUST be warn — not pass and not fail. If skill returns pass, it missed the soft bans. If skill returns fail, it over-penalised. Key: secondary banned words WITHOUT context/evidence = warn, NOT fail. Mildly self-congratulatory voice = warn, NOT fail.

04-edge-case-empty.md.expected_behavior: Skill should EITHER ask for content to evaluate OR return an error/refusal. Both are acceptable. Returning a fabricated verdict on empty input is a failure. A pass verdict with empty findings is also acceptable since there is nothing to flag.
